### 2. Your role

Selected systems/maturity only; retain calculations, design/decision/authority/interface registers and gaps. Mains/rain/river/carted/reuse are not interchangeable; metering is not full controls.
Fire designer owns wet fire/storage/pumps; fire engineer owns strategy. Trades install/test; consultant review/witness is not execution or unseen-work certification.

### 3. Scope by stage

R2 sets maturity, native formats, revisions, review rounds, recipients/reliance and dates. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

|---|---|

| S2 Investigation | Selected tracing/CCTV/flow/logging/sampling; access/isolation/reinstatement, limits; upgrades separate |
| S3 Concept | Brief/options/preliminary demands; source/storage/treatment, spatial/access and cost inputs |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Preliminary options/spatial advice; detailed design separate; Detailed potable/hot-water/sanitary: pressure/flow/backflow/grades/vents/scald/meters; Rain/river/carted/reuse/irrigation: source-specific quality/treatment evidence; Detailed domestic tank/pump/booster design; fire separate; Detailed roof/terrace primary/overflow drainage; Trade waste/arrestors/discharge: contaminants required, kitchenette insufficient; Evidenced gas; medical/lab/process fluids by competent specialist; Utility/build-over/sewer proximity; WSC separate; no guaranteed approval; Coordinate supports/fire-stop/waterproofing/power/BMS; specialists design; Retained-system investigation; facts/assumptions separate; upgrades separate; Phase/tenancy meters/access/acceptance and temporary services; Applicable declarations/lodgement owner; verify jurisdiction/competence.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Separate continued design/novation; Quantified construction support; Selected witnessing/handover; trades execute tests; Defined defects/operational verification.
Excluded: the party named does it: Treatment design; reticulation stops at agreed flow boundary (treatment designer, not yet engaged); Site drainage/detention/overland flow/easements; no civil from internal fit-out (civil engineer, not yet engaged); Fixture selection; hydraulic checks demand/connections (the architect).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

**Responsibility schedule**: For every shared connection name design owner, upstream/downstream boundary, capacity/quality evidence provider, installer, controls owner, test executor, witness and acceptance owner. Unresolved allocations stay open.

| System / interface | Allocation and acceptance basis |
|---|---|
| Domestic/fire | Separate demands/storage/pumps; source/refill/backflow/space; one shared-infrastructure designer. |
| Roof/civil | Downpipe/below-ground handover levels/capacity; pits/detention/overland flow/easements. |
| Sewer/treatment | Reticulation/flow boundary; treatment acceptance/quality/capacity evidence; separate treatment designer. |
| Trade/process | Contaminants/arrestors/pretreatment/discharge consent; specialist process-treatment boundary if present. |
| Landscape | Supply point/quality/demand; water-feature/irrigation designers own downstream. |
| Condensate | Agree mechanical connection level, receiving capacity, falls, traps, tundish and discharge; name upstream/downstream design and test owners. |
| Utility | Internal/utility limits; provider/WSC author/submitter/payer, approval/test acceptance. |

### 6. Terms

- Engage under Project hydraulic agreement (attached), scope/fees/addenda, written acceptance and settled precedence. RFP authorises no work.
- Preauthorise scope/quantity/ceiling/rate/program changes with reason and design/approval/cost/time effects.
- Approved baseline includes normal coordination/design development.
- Own-error correction included; reasonable skill/care within competence.
- Pay 30 days from correct milestone invoice; declare prepayment/release/interest/recovery/suspension in R6.
- State rate hold/escalation; preapprove extras/expenses; no duplicate fees.
- Valid 90 days after closing; ex GST/GST/total for base/options.
- Questions to Project manager by 2026-10-23; numbered addenda to all, acknowledged in R1.
- Agree project copying/distribution/operation/alteration rights, native files/reliance/retention/termination handover; authorised/lawful disclosure allowed, marketing by consent.
- Settle caps/indemnities/law/disputes/notices/cure/termination/suspension/novation/subcontracts; insurance not a cap; agree conflicts/staff changes.

### 7. Evaluation

Price 40% · Experience 20% · Team 20% · Method/program 10% · Compliance 10%. Compare equivalent systems, sources, interfaces, maturity and attendance.
